name: lotrace
description: LotRace — classic Brazilian-style property board PWA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @lotrace/backend" "npm run dev -w @lotrace/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lotrace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lotrace/backend && npm run typecheck -w @lotrace/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lotrace/shared && npm run lint -w @lotrace/backend && npm run lint -w @lotrace/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lotrace/shared && npm run test -w @lotrace/backend
